inputs.text: A quiet rooftop terrace of a city apartment building at golden hour, completely empty, no people. Warm terracotta floor tiles. Straight ahead a waist-high white plastered parapet wall with a thin black metal handrail along its top, running across the whole frame. On the left side, a tall olive tree and green plants in large terracotta pots against a white wall. On the right side, a simple long wooden slatted bench with no cushions, placed against the white parapet wall. Beyond the parapet, a soft hazy city skyline of low-rise cream and beige buildings and a few distant trees, the sun low in the sky on the right, warm golden light, long soft shadows across the tiles, clear sky fading from gold to soft blue. Cinematic 16:9 film still, photorealistic, shot on a high-end digital cinema camera, crisp and clean, sharp fine detail, noise-free, no film grain, natural warm golden-hour colour grade, true-to-life colours, gentle contrast. Single continuous full-frame shot, no text.
